title: Union Glacier Camp services — Antarctic Logistics & Expeditions
claims: Union Glacier Camp is at 79°46′S 82°52′W, elevation 2,297 ft (700 m), in the southern Ellsworth Mountains on Union Glacier.
The camp is accessible only by air and operates during the Antarctic summer from November to January; it is dismantled at the end of each season.
Union Glacier camp time is the same as Punta Arenas, Chile, GMT-3, even though the camp has 24-hour daylight.
The camp is about 2,991 km from the southern tip of Chile and just over 1,000 km from the South Pole.
